decisions.reason: The relocation preference changes physical placement of lower main-board connectors, not the interboard connector types, pinouts, roles, or power-chain semantics.
The source concerns lower connectors on the main board, while this Requirement governs battery and interboard connector accessibility on the power board.
Rearranging connector and component placement does not change the main board's four-layer stack.
The source proposes an internal placement arrangement but does not change the established 70 by 50 mm board dimensions.
Connector relocation within the main board does not alter the four-board topology or the separation of functional boards.
The source does not mention or logically alter the requirement that the ESP32 antenna remain at the PCB edge.
The proposed arrangement applies to lower main-board connectors and does not affect power-board dimensions, orientation, mounting, or USB-C placement.
The main-board connector placement preference has no effect on the power board's four-layer stack.
The source changes possible placement of lower connectors on the main board but does not change the sensor board's connector inventory, signals, or fanout role.
Placing other components below the relocated connector row does not change the monitored rails, monitor device, channel count, or measurement coverage.
The source does not identify the lower connectors as panel-control connectors and does not change their inventory, signals, or external-connection policy.
The source does not identify the charge-status connector and does not alter its presence, type, signal, resistance, or population settings.
